title: Batch 1 Gaps: URP + Extreme Optimization Items
description:
Implement URP and Extreme Optimization items from plan 01-ai-core that were not built in the initial implementation.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

URP (§16):
- §16.2 EventStream Leak Detection: In test builds, track unclosed EventStreams via runtime.SetFinalizer. Log warning with creation stack trace if GC'd without Close().

Extreme Optimization (§17):
- §17.1 SSE Zero-Copy Parsing: Reuse single []byte buffer for line reading, only allocate strings on event completion. Benchmark with unsafe.String for zero-copy views. Verify B2 SSE benchmark improves.
- §17.3 Large JSON Streaming: For ToolCall.Arguments exceeding 64KB, use json.NewDecoder with streaming instead of json.Unmarshal. Add benchmark for large argument payloads.

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.md §16 (URP), §17 (Extreme Optimization)
- Test harness: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §5 (B2 SSE benchmark)
